exposure: spinal anesthesia use for cesarean delivery
outcome: attitude of mothers towards spinal anesthesia
complications of spinal anesthesia (hypotension, postdural puncture headache)
cohort: The study participants were mothers undergoing cesarean delivery at Tikur Anbessa Specialized Hospital and Gandhi Memorial Hospital in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia.
finding: The overall proportion of cesarean delivery with spinal anesthesia was 68.2%, which is significantly lower than reported rates from developed and sub-Saharan countries, with 90.3% of mothers happy with the anesthesia type.
mod_finding: The overall cesarean section delivery prevalence during the study period was 32.5%.
